entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 0.21 +/- 0.03 solar radii from Muirhead et al. 2015, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of Kepler-445 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015ApJ...801...18M/abstract). Mass 0.18 +/- 0.04 solar masses from Muirhead et al. 2015, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of Kepler-445 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015ApJ...801...18M/abstract). Temperature 3157 +/- 60 K from Muirhead et al. 2015, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of Kepler-445 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive.

entries.subject: Colour
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 3,157 K, because no archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffbd77. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret (2017), A&A 600, A30 computes from PHOENIX model atmospheres for the TESS band at 3,157 K and log g 5.05 (u1 0.157, u2 0.488): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
